text:
deploy-bot: Starting canary rollout for service/servex image=servex:v2.14.1-hotfix (canary=10%)
lucy: Noted. What's the risk summary?
mike: Hotfix addresses crash during GC under high mem pressure. Repro rate ~100% on the broken path.
qa-lead: Verified fix in staging — no regression on core flows. test-suite: all green except flaky e2e 12.
lucy: Change window? we're in a limited-change window until 18:00 UTC.
ryan-pm: This is customer-impacting for a subset of heavy inference customers. Recommend expedited approval for faster rollout.
ops-oncall: We need ops + eng signoff to bypass standard 30m canary. Suggest reduced canary length (5m) and standby rollback plan.
lucy: @ops-oncall can you confirm autoscaler and circuit-breakers are set to conservative?
ops-oncall: Autoscaler min=2 max=10, cb thresholds temporarily lowered. Logs routed to hotfix channel.
mike: I can hold pager and watch metrics during the reduced canary window. Ready to rollback image->servex:v2.14.0 if issues.
qa-lead: Recommending smoke checks: /health, /infer?model=base, tail 200 logs for error signature. I have the checklist: `curl -sS http://svc/health && curl -sS http://svc/infer?model=base -d '{"input":"test"}'`
sara: +1 from SRE on monitoring dashboards and alerts. Alerts quiet in last 24h.
lucy: OK lets do expedited: lucy approves (product/security checked). mike please deploy canary at 10% for 5m, then 50% for 10m after green. ops-oncall stand by for rollback.
deploy-bot: Canary step 1-> 10% deployed. pods: 2/2 ready.
mike: Kicking off reduced canary now. Watching qps/latency/errors.
ops-oncall: Deployed smoke checks running, no new 5xx. Latency stable.
qa-lead: Running quick regression set now. No crashes observed in 5m window.
deploy-bot: Canary step 2-> 50% scheduled in 5 minutes per approval.
ryan-pm: Documenting release note: "v2.14.1-hotfix: fixed GC crash under high-memory inference, hotfix rolled under expedited approval; fallback available to v2.14.0"
lucy: Mike, if any spike in 5xx or crash signature, rollback immediately and call this channel.
mike: Affirmative. Rollback command ready: `kubectl set image deploy/servex servex=servex:v2.14.0 --record`
ops-oncall: Also keeping standby node pool ready for scale-down anomalies.
sara: Telemetry suggests error count down to zero in canary pods. No customer reports so far.
deploy-bot: Canary 10% -> healthy at 5m. Proceeding to 50%.
mike: Moving to 50% now. Will watch for 10m and then final roll if green.
lucy: +1 final from product, proceed to full rollout after 10m green. Make sure release notes go out in #customer-updates.
ryan-pm: I'll assemble a short release note and post after full rollout.
qa-lead: Post-deploy: run full regression overnight, will file followup if any anomalies.
deploy-bot: Canary 50% -> healthy at 10m. Scheduling full rollout in 2m.
mike: Full rollout started.
ops-oncall: Monitoring for 30m post-full-rollout per SLO. Standby rollback window open.
deploy-bot: Full rollout complete: 100% servex:v2.14.1-hotfix.
lucy: Great work — marking expedited approval done. Thanks everyone. :tada:
ryan-pm: Release note posted to #customer-updates and release docs. Closing thread once overnight checks are clean.
qa-lead: Leaving a note: follow-up ticket #INT-4123 for expanded e2e flake investigation.
mike: If any regression pops up, will reopen this thread and trigger rollback.
deploy-bot: Audit: rollout performed by mike via expedited-approval flow, reason=customer-impacting-crash, approvals=[lucy, sara, ops-oncall].
